sections.title: The US and Iran trade fire again
sections.body: US jets struck an Iranian missile launch site on Qeshm late on 17 November. Iran answered with drones at Kuwait, its first attack there in two months, and Bahrain, which reported four attacks in six days. Qatar called Iran's attacks a dangerous escalation. The New York Times reports US and Israeli plans for renewed strikes on energy targets.

sections.title: Tankers burn north of Khasab
sections.body: The LPG tanker Tara Gas was hit on 16 and 17 November and abandoned, with an Indian seafarer missing; an ADNOC tanker was attacked on 17 November, one missing and 11 injured. CENTCOM said ships taking Iranian cargo at sea may be seized. The IEA called the Hormuz crisis the largest threat to energy security in history.

sections.title: The Crimean Bridge falls
sections.body: A Ukrainian missile and drone attack on 17 November dropped a road section of the Crimean Bridge into the Kerch Strait; a third attack on 19 November halted rail traffic. Russia struck Kyiv's two Dnipro bridges, and attacks killed 14 people across Ukraine on 17 November. A Pentagon official called deep strikes ineffective; Germany and Britain disagreed.

sections.title: Shenzhen opens with bilaterals
sections.body: Xi met Trump at the airport and the two held talks on 19 November, after Trump met Putin for nearly an hour; the Kremlin said no important statements were made. The three-way meeting was scheduled for that afternoon. Russia flew nuclear-capable bombers to Vietnam, and Russian aircraft violated Japan's airspace.

sections.title: Russia's hybrid pressure on the West
sections.body: US prosecutors charged a Russian with spying on staff of a defence firm that supplies Ukraine, reportedly Palantir. Poland reinforced its Kaliningrad border after a reported false-flag plot. Seven Russian drones entered Moldova, which summoned Russia's envoy, and two ships sank off Bulgaria in two days, one after a reported sea-drone attack.

sections.title: Gaza's ceasefire line is crossed
sections.body: Israeli tanks crossed the ceasefire line into Hamas-held central Gaza on 18 November, the first such armoured incursion of the truce, displacing 5,200 people; Hamas called it a blatant violation. Israel killed Hamas's Rafah brigade commander on 14 November. In Yemen, the Saudi-led coalition struck 60 Houthi targets.

key_developments: US jets strike a missile site on Qeshm on 17 November; Iran fires drones at Kuwait for the first time in two months.
A Crimean Bridge road section collapses into the Kerch Strait; a third attack halts rail traffic on 19 November.
Trump meets Putin for nearly an hour, then Xi, in Shenzhen on 19 November.
Two tankers hit near Khasab: two seafarers missing, 11 injured; CENTCOM extends the blockade to ship-to-ship transfers.
Russian Tu-95 bombers land in Vietnam, a first since the Soviet era; Japan reports an airspace violation.
Israeli tanks cross the Gaza ceasefire line for the first time since the truce.
since_last_visit_brief: The US struck an Iranian missile site and Iran fired drones at Kuwait and Bahrain, while Ukraine brought down part of the Crimean Bridge.
